meta.name: Ms Marvel
meta.description: A great student, avid gamer, and voracious fan-fic scribe, Kamala Khan has a special affinity for superheroes, particularly Captain Marvel. However, she struggles to fit in at home and at school — that is, until she gets superpowers like the heroes she’s always looked up to. Life is easier with superpowers, right?

videos.title: Generation Why
videos.overview: Kamala Khan attends Avengercon only to discover that she herself might have superpowers.

videos.title: Crushed
videos.overview: Kamala and Bruno explore the source of her newfound powers just in time for a perilous adventure.

videos.title: Destined
videos.overview: Ahead of Aamir’s wedding, Kamala may face grave consequences due to a crucial decision she makes.

videos.title: Seeing Red
videos.overview: Kamala travels around the world to solve the mystery of the bangle and her family’s history.

videos.title: Time and Again
videos.overview: The bangle reveals to Kamala secrets about her family lineage, as well as the truth behind the Veil.

videos.title: No Normal
videos.overview: Back in Jersey, Kamala finds Kamran and protects him from Damage Control who will stop at nothing to take him in.

meta.slogan: The future is in her hands.
